hook: Oberoi group plans *₹777 crore* Trident near RGIA
hook_b: Oberoi group plans *₹777 crore* Trident near RGIA
tldr: EIH Ltd's board approved a five-star Trident hotel on an 8.89-acre plot it already owns near Rajiv Gandhi International Airport.

beats.what: The hotel is expected to open by September 2030 and serve domestic and international travellers, per a regulatory filing cited by Siasat.
beats.why: EIH said it will cater to travellers near RGIA; the group already runs a Trident in HITEC City.
beats.care: A big hotel build near the airport adds to Shamshabad's growth as a hospitality hub.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: EIH revenue from operations rose about 16% to ₹694.19 crore in July-September.

cards.q: What does the airport area need more?

qs: Will a new airport hotel bring local jobs before 2030?

facts.t: The hotel will rise on an *8.89-acre* plot EIH already owns near RGIA.

viz.verdict: Profit up for the company; hotel opens by Sept 2030

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: New Trident hotel to come up near Hyderabad airport by 2030

fact: Oberoi group to build *₹777 crore* Trident hotel near Shamshabad airport by 2030.
twist: EIH's quarterly profit rose *21%* to ₹141.46 crore, announced the same day the board cleared the hotel.
